study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: TractoInferno: 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from 6 sites, used for pretraining. NIMHANS: 302 participants (123 CN, 89 MCI, 90 AD) from 2 scanners (Philips Ingenia and Siemens Skyra) in India, used for fine-tuning and inference.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset [32], acquired on 3T scanners from 6 sites. ... We analyzed 3T diffusion MRI (dMRI) data in a sample of 302 participants from two scanners from the NIMHANS (National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences) cohort (see Table I) in India.

answer.TractoInferno: generative pretraining for normative model (198 healthy subjects)

answer.NIMHANS: fine-tuning (50 CN) and inference/testing (remaining CN, MCI, AD subjects)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: TractoInferno was used for pretraining to encode complex tract geometric features. NIMHANS CN subjects were split: 50 for fine-tuning (stratified by sex and scanner), remaining for inference along with MCI and AD subjects for group difference testing.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The model ... was pretrained for 29,000 steps, with a batch size of 512 on the TractoInferno dataset. Fifty CN subjects from the NIMHANS dataset, randomly selected and stratified by sex and scanner, were then used to fine-tune the model for 5000 steps. At inference time, bundle profiles from the remaining CN, MCI, and AD subjects were passed through the model...
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Feng2024.pdf.md: III. METHOD / B. Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT), L69-71

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Pretraining: 198 healthy subjects from TractoInferno. Fine-tuning: 50 CN from NIMHANS. Total healthy controls used for normative model training = 198 + 50 = 248. Note: The remaining 73 CN from NIMHANS (123 - 50 = 73) were used only at inference time for group comparison, not for model training.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset ... Fifty CN subjects from the NIMHANS dataset, randomly selected and stratified by sex and scanner, were then used to fine-tune the model for 5000 steps.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age information for the pretraining dataset (TractoInferno, 198 subjects) is not reported in this paper. For NIMHANS, total cohort age is 67.26 +/- 7.86 years, but this includes MCI and AD patients. Age for the 50 CN used for fine-tuning is not separately reported. Scanner-wise ages are: Philips Ingenia 67.67 +/- 7.13 (all diagnoses), Siemens Skyra 67.02 +/- 8.26 (all diagnoses).
